text:
jun (newhire): hey folks, first day! trying to kick off the onboarding Buildkite pipeline `onboarding/first-build` from my PR but it never starts. buildkite shows: "Queued — waiting for agents" and the PR status is pending. any obvious first-week mistakes?
alejandra (infra): welcome! do you see any errors in the Buildkite web UI logs? sometimes the github app install or org scopes block status updates.
jun (newhire): the pipeline page has a little red triangle if I click details: `Failed to update commit status: 403 Forbidden (GitHub App not installed on this repo)` — not sure what that means.
sam (devex): that means our Buildkite ↔ GitHub App doesn't have a binding for this repo/org or your account's org SSO. are you in the redwood-inference org and did you accept the GitHub App permissions when you joined?
jun (newhire): i joined the org yesterday and accepted invites. where do i check the app?
alejandra (infra): go to https://github.com/organizations/redwood-inference/settings/installations and check if "Buildkite" is listed and installed for the repo. if it's missing, ping infra to request install. also check your org SSO link — if you haven't completed SAML SSO we block app access.
jun (newhire): ok i see Buildkite listed but it says "installed on select repositories" and this PR's repo isn't checked. looks like it's not auto-installed for forks.
morgan (eng-oncall): for the onboarding repo we intentionally keep the app narrow. easiest quickfix: add the `pipeline:manual-run` tag to your PR comment to let CI run on shared agents, or we can add your repo to the app install.
jun (newhire): tried adding comment: `@buildkite run pipeline:onboarding/first-build tags=[shared]` — deploy-bot replied `Pipeline scheduled` but build still shows queued with `no agents match tags: shared`
deploy-bot: Pipeline "onboarding/first-build" scheduled by jun (newhire). Waiting for agents with tags: [shared].
sam (devex): ah near-term: join the `ci-onboarding` GitHub team (gives repo access and lets the app post statuses). i'll add you temporarily. also check if you can run a local build: `buildkite-agent start --token $BK_AGENT_TOKEN` — though agents are limited.
alejandra (infra): filing a quick ticket to expand the Buildkite App install to include the repo and grant checks:write, statuses:read for the app. @sam if you can add jun to `ci-onboarding`, that should unblock their PR status.
morgan (eng-oncall): likewise, if you get a 403 when trying to push a PR status, try `gh auth login` and make sure SSO is enabled. For now, @jun i've manually triggered a fallback runner for your pipeline — you should see a new build start in ~30s.
jun (newhire): sweet — build started! logs show one flaky test failing but at least the pipeline can run. thanks all :thumbsup:
